gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-gambetta: Gambetta carries the bookish, graceful voice here, its stroke weight shifting visibly without ever turning dramatic. Gambetta gives Bruno Ace SC, bent like a single length of wire with its letters strung out like beads, a gentler counterweight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-lora: Sharp and engraved, Bruno Ace SC keeps one cut depth across every letter, spaced out like beads on a thread. Lora follows with a restful text serif whose modest swings in stroke weight soften the page.
